+"""Record preparation steps."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from typing import Any
+
+from _pytest.compat import is_async_function
+
+
+def _validated_fields(record: object) -> tuple[str, Any, bool]:
+    """Validate a record and return its (trimmed key, value, enabled) fields."""
+    if not isinstance(record, dict):
+        raise ValueError("record must be a dict")
+    key = record.get("key")
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip():
+        raise ValueError("record key must be a nonempty string")
+    if "value" not in record:
+        raise ValueError("record must have a value entry")
+    enabled = record.get("enabled", True)
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("record enabled must be a bool")
+    return key.strip(), record["value"], enabled
+
+
+def prepare_with(record: object, render: Callable[[Any], Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Validate ``record`` and return a new prepared dict whose display is
+    ``render(value)``. The input is never mutated."""
+    key, value, enabled = _validated_fields(record)
+    return {"key": key, "value": value, "display": render(value), "enabled": enabled}
+
+
+def display_async(value: object) -> bool:
+    """Whether ``value`` is an async function under the pytest detection
+    semantics (coroutine functions and async generator functions)."""
+    return bool(is_async_function(value))
+
+
+def prepare(record: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Prepare a record, displaying whether its value is an async function."""
+    return prepare_with(record, display_async)

 def prepare(record: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
     """Prepare a record, displaying whether its value is an async function."""
     return prepare_with(record, display_async)
+
+
+def batch_with(records: object, render: Callable[[Any], Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Prepare each record with ``render`` in input order, rejecting
+    non-list input and duplicate trimmed keys (disabled entries included)."""
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        raise ValueError("records must be a list")
+    prepared: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for record in records:
+        item = prepare_with(record, render)
+        if item["key"] in seen:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate record key: {item['key']!r}")
+        seen.add(item["key"])
+        prepared.append(item)
+    return prepared
+
+
+def batch(records: object) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Prepare a list of records with the async-function display."""
+    return batch_with(records, display_async)

+    """Group display values of enabled records by first character of their

+    groups: dict[str, list[Any]] = {}
+    for item in batch_with(records, render):

+            groups.setdefault(item["key"][0], []).append(item["display"])
+    return groups

+    """Group async-function displays of enabled records by key initial."""
+    return group_with(records, display_async)
